chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Saeed, from Musaddaq ibn Sadaqa, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The shroud should be Burda (fabric); if it is not Burda, then make it all cotton. If you do not find a cotton turban, then make the turban Sabiriyya (fabric).

key_terms.بُرْداً: A specific type of fine fabric, preferred for shrouds
key_terms.سَابِرِيّاً: A specific type of fabric, used as an alternative for the turban

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended order of fabric for a Muslim's shroud according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a clear hierarchy for the shroud, prioritizing Burda fabric for its durability and prestige, then cotton for accessibility, and finally Sabiriyya for the turban, reflecting the Shia emphasis on dignified yet practical burial rites. This guidance underscores the principle of avoiding extravagance while maintaining respect for the deceased, a key theme in Shia fiqh regarding funeral practices. The specification of materials also highlights the importance of using pure, natural fibers, aligning with the broader Islamic value of simplicity in death.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Bin Musa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The shroud should happen to be Burda (a fabric), so if it cannot happen to be Burda, so make all of it to be cotton. If you cannot find a cotton turban, so make the turban to be of Sabiriyya (a fabric)’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ali from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from ‘Ammar ibn Musa who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Shroud can be made of Burd; if Burd is not available, then the whole shroud is of cotton. If a turban of cotton is not available, then Sabiriy fabric can be used for this purpose.’”
